name: Robyg S.A.
summary: Robyg S.A. engages in the construction and sale of residential and commercial properties in Poland. The company develops small studios for singles and two-room dwellings for couples, and larger apartments. It also provides installation services for solar panels and energy-efficient LED lighting. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland. Robyg S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Tag Beteiligungs- Und Immobilienverwaltungs GmbH.
